title: Backend Developer - Web Platform
description: About MEAtec: At MEAtec , we build advanced digital solutions for the battery industry, with a focus on Battery Passport and Battery Analytics platforms. We are a fast-growing team of engineers, designers, and innovators passionate about sustainability, traceability, and performance in the battery lifecycle. Join us to help shape the digital future of clean energy. Position Overview: We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our growing team and help build the core services behind our Battery Passport and Battery Analytics platforms. In this role, you will design and develop scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services and APIs that power data-driven web applications. You will primarily work with Node.js and AWS-based cloud infrastructure to build reliable systems that support real-time data processing, traceability, and analytics across the battery lifecycle. You will collaborate closely with frontend developers, DevOps, and product teams to deliver end-to-end features “from API design and implementation to deployment” with continuous improvement in a fast-paced and agile environment. Key Responsibilities: Contribute to the development of new features and enhancements for our web platform and back-end systems, ensuring high performance and responsiveness. Architect and implement robust back-end services, APIs, and server-side logic. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers and product managers, to deliver exceptional user experiences. Conduct code reviews across back-end codebases. Troubleshoot and debug complex issues to optimize application performance. Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve our tech stack. Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate deployment and testing processes. Manage and optimize AWS cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability. Maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or Bicep to automate infrastructure provisioning. Development Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (Tier 1 or Tier 2 universities preferred). 1-3 years of hands-on backend development experience using Node.js in production environments, with exposure to microservices architecture. Strong proficiency in back-end development with microservice architecture using Node.js. Understanding of server-side technologies (Express.js, Nest.js, etc.) Experience with databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and infrastructure technologies (RabbitMQ/Kafka/SQS, Redis, ElasticSearch, AWS Cognito). Proficiency with Docker for containerization and Kubernetes for orchestration. Experience in writing unit and integration tests using Jest (or similar testing frameworks) is required. Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline and AWS cloud services (S3, Cognito, API Gateway, ElasticSearch etc.) Excellent problem-solving and debugging abilities. Strong attention to detail - Effective communication and collaboration skills. Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using Terraform or Bicep. Experience with system monitoring and logging tools to track application performance, availability, and security. Experience in front-end development with React (Redux, React Router, etc.) is a plus. What We Offer: Hands-on experience in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. Opportunities to work on impactful projects that drive innovation. Competitive salary and benefits package. Supportive team culture within an international work environment. Professional development and mentorship opportunities. Join us at MEATEC and take the next step in your web development career!

title: React Native Developer (Remote)
description: Role : React Native Developer (Remote) Location : Remote (Work from Anywhere) Job Type : Contract Payout : $40 - $120/hour Role Overview: We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a React Native Developer to work on a contract basis. The role involves building and maintaining cross-platform mobile applications using React Native technology. Key Responsibilities: • Develop and optimize mobile applications using React Native framework for iOS and Android platforms • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features • Debug and resolve issues across multiple mobile platforms efficiently • Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following best practices • Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions Required Skills & Qualifications: • Proficiency in React Native development with at least 2 years of hands-on experience • Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend development practices • Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or Context API • Knowledge of mobile app performance optimization techniques • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services • Experience with version control systems like Git • Understanding of mobile app security best practices • Ability to work independently in a remote environment More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Software Development industry, contributing to the delivery of high-quality mobile applications for a diverse user base. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. Apply Now!

title: Full Stack Development Academy
description: Neon Apps · Neon Academy · Istanbul (Sarıyer office) Start your career by learning how real production software is built. As a Full Stack trainee at Neon Academy, you'll work through a structured, hands-on curriculum reviewed by working developers, and then move into real client and product work. This is not a course. Every day produces a concrete output, everything you write is reviewed, and you build toward shipping something that runs in production. Neon Academy is a training programme for people who want to become software developers but have not yet had the chance to gain industry experience. We don't expect professional experience. What we expect is evidence that you've finished something on your own. The journey. Neon Academy runs for six to nine months. Your first two months are structured training: a curriculum built on the methods we use across 500+ real projects, with hands-on tasks to complete every day and working developers as your mentors. You then build a graduation project of your own. From there the guidance is gradually removed and, as you stand out, you take ownership of real client and product work, with a chance to join the permanent team at the end. So far Neon Academy has trained more than 1,000 people, and over 200 of them have gone on to join the Neon Apps team. You'll work from our Sarıyer office with transportation and meal support. What you'll do Work through the curriculum one task at a time and meet each task's acceptance criteria Build backend services with TypeScript and NestJS, then build the interface on top with Next.js Open branches, send pull requests, take review, and act on the feedback you receive Containerise the service you built, deploy it to the cloud, and follow what happens next Write technical documentation: setup steps, environment variables, and the reasoning behind your decisions Come to mentor review sessions prepared to explain why you built it the way you did Requirements Fluency in TypeScript. The programme assumes it from day one. We teach how to use the language well, not the language itself At least one project you finished. Small is fine, half-finished is not You can talk through your own work: which decisions you made and why, where you got stuck, and what you'd do differently today. We look at this more closely than at code quality Familiarity with git and a pull request workflow Able to take part in the programme full time Enough English to read technical documentation. The curriculum is in English You do not need professional work experience. That is exactly who this programme is for. Preferred qualifications None of these are filters and we don't expect any of them. If you have even one, tell us. Backend: a project written with NestJS · Express or Fastify · FastAPI or Django Databases: PostgreSQL or another relational database with migrations · a non-relational store such as MongoDB or Redis Frontend: interface work with Next.js or React Infrastructure: Docker and container-based development · any attempt at deploying to a cloud provider · a CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines) Other: another programming language (Python, Go, Java, C#, PHP) · open source contributions, however small · previous internship experience · having worked with AI agents and reviewed the code they produced How we read your portfolio Three considered projects beat ten near-identical tutorial clones. What tells us something is not the polish, it's why you chose to build it. A small tool you wrote because you wanted it to exist says more than a large application built for a course. If your README explains what you built and what you'd do differently, you've already shown us what we're looking for. What you'll gain Hands-on experience building and shipping real production software One-on-one mentorship from working developers Experience with a modern, AI-assisted engineering workflow A strong foundation for a career as a full stack developer, and a path onto our permanent team Transportation & meal support, Sarıyer office Not required A computer science degree, or any degree · previous internship experience · knowledge of a specific framework · stars, followers or a contribution graph on GitHub. Process Application and portfolio review A short conversation about what you've built and what you want to work on A technical conversation where you walk us through one of your own projects. There's no test to solve. We talk about the work you bring and ask why you made specific decisions
